units.source_text: 良平什么都不顾了，他顺着轨道的一侧不停地奔跑了一阵，

en.t: Ryohei no longer cared about anything, and ran for a while along one side of the tracks,

units.source_text: 突然发觉兜里的那包点心有些累赘，

en.t: when he suddenly realized that the package of sweets in his pocket was something of a burden,

units.source_text: 他果断的把点心扔到了路边，

en.t: so he decisively threw the sweets to the roadside,

units.source_text: 然后又把脚上的木底草履也脱下扔了。

en.t: and then he took off the wooden-soled sandals on his feet and threw them away too.

units.source_text: 这样，虽然小石子扎到薄薄的布袜子里了，

en.t: In this way, although small stones dug into his thin cloth socks,

units.source_text: 但是两只脚跑起来倒是轻快多了。

en.t: his feet actually felt much lighter when he ran.

units.source_text: 良平能够感觉到海洋就在他的左边，

en.t: Ryohei could sense the sea right there on his left,
and just then he ran up a steep slope.
Tears kept threatening to well up in his eyes,

units.source_text: 整张脸自然扭曲成一团。

en.t: and his whole face twisted up of its own accord.
Even if he forced back the tears,

units.source_text: 可是鼻子总也忍不住抽抽搭搭。

en.t: his nose still would not stop sniffling.
